name: 财报排雷
description_zh: 输入一只股票，快速提取财报三表核心指标、多期趋势对比、七维度财务异常检测、盈利能力诊断与同业对标，一分钟判断"这公司财务健不健康、有没有雷"。
description_en: Rapidly extract core indicators from the three financial statements, compare multi-period trends, run a seven-dimension financial anomaly detection, diagnose profitability, and benchmark against industry peers. Determine in one minute whether a company financials are healthy or carry hidden risks.
